Turns out it's slower than the free version. I'm going back to my "old" spreadsheet that works for me. I'm always searching for a good app that will help with budgeting so I don't have to sit at my computer to do it but instead can update it on the go. Intentions are good but needs more work to be worth paying $10/mo. Some of the things that didnt work for me are: My funds didn't add up. There was no easy way to see all monthly transactions unless you click on a category. The mobile app doesn't give you the option to add a new budget group. If you applied a transaction to the wrong month, there was no "easy" way to move it to the correct month. You have to the website, delete it, go to the correct month, go to deleted transactions, then edit it and put it in the correct category. Too much work. You should be able to change the month you're applying it to when you edit it.

I can see that this would be a good start, but once the monthly totals are set, I'd rather transition into the current pay period. It would be much more straightforward if I could then handle my money and transactions by paycheck, not the month as a whole, when I'm actually only currently handling a portion of that total monthly income at any given point. I get paid weekly, so only being able to view the month as a whole is rather inconvenient.  (The app also appears blank when I first open it, but does work after entirely closing out of the app and reopening it.)
